independent_preflight.scope: Exact plan only; no implementation acceptance.

lead_approval.rationale: Root requirements/source/design-case reads and distinct Astra/xhigh exact-plan PASS. Three configuration lines with one existing-fixture native forwarding case and two controls; no resource creation, automatic recovery or customer retention policy.

limitations: Isolated local DLQ declarations and installed native broker retry-exhaustion forwarding only. Test-only collector proves full-body forwarding, not consumerless retention, restart durability, deployed retry semantics, native concurrency or operational recovery. Queue existence/activation, access/retention/erasure/alerts/recovery ownership and customer/privacy decisions need separate authority. Producer rejection, intentionally acknowledged non-ledger/handled scene failures, replay/reconciliation, partial/legacy duplication, full W09/W22/F16/N10 and release remain open. Retired scripts remain retired. No commit/push/install/emitted build/deploy/provision/cloud/credentials/customer-data/destructive/external operations.
